title: Real Madrid’s Raul Asencio to miss Getafe match with neck injury
content:
Raul Asencio will miss Real Madrid’s match against Getafe on Monday after straining the muscles in his neck during their Champions League play-off win against Benfica.

The 23-year-old defender collided with team-mate Eduardo Camavinga in the second half of Wednesday’s 2-1 win and was taken off on a stretcher, wearing a neck brace. He was taken to hospital that evening and started his recovery at the Spanish side’s training ground on Thursday.

The club confirmed in a statement that he had been diagnosed with a cervical muscle strain.

The Spaniard could be available for the following league match against Celta Vigo on March 7, depending on his recovery from the muscle strain.

Asencio has made 29 appearances this season in all competitions, scoring two goals and providing two assists.

“Thanks for all the messages of encouragement,” he said on his social media on Thursday. “That was just a scare!! Let’s go for the next round, Hala Madrid!!!”

Madrid could also be without Kylian Mbappe for the Getafe fixture, who missed the second leg against Benfica with an ongoing knee issue, while Jude Bellingham is still sidelined with a hamstring injury.

Asencio remains under investigation after allegations over allegedly sharing of a sex tape involving a minor. In September, The Athletic reported that he would stand trial over the 2023 incident, though he has always maintained his innocence.
